visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a patterned shirt stands on a vibrant stage with a pink background and 'Taipei Toy Show' banners, holding a microphone and gesturing to the audience. A woman in white stands beside him. (2) A group of people joins the man on stage for a ribbon-cutting or opening ceremony, holding large circular placards with characters on them. The crowd in the foreground is seen from behind. (3) The camera pans across glass display cases showcasing various designer toys, including a white wolf in a blue cape, a tan dog with a waffle hat, and stylized human figures in street clothes. (4) Close-ups of monster-like figures and crayfish-themed toys are shown, featuring detailed textures and vibrant colors like orange, blue, and purple. (5) In a booth area, a man explains a product to two visitors while pointing at manga-style posters on a wall. A large white and red robot figure stands nearby. (6) Further showcases reveal a 'Luffy' figure in a dynamic pose and several colorful futuristic racing car models. (7) Multiple plush and vinyl toys from brands like 'Fuggler' and 'Jinart' are displayed, including a large purple monster with prominent teeth and rows of small, character-based blind box figures. (8) An 'Ultraman' mascot interacts with a crowd of children and parents on a red carpet. The man from the start poses for a photo with the mascot. (9) At the 'Infinity Toy' booth, muscular action figures in various colors and some feline-like monsters are highlighted. (10) A young boy participates in a prize draw using a hexagonal drum, and finally, a family of three poses together holding a branded shopping bag.
